answer: Let standing arrive only along several paths that share no intermediary, each capped at a small weight, like streams feeding a lagoon: one sponsor can open only one stream. A sybil farmer's shells all hang from the same few sponsors, so their trust stalls at the cap however many shells spawn, while an honest agent gathers distinct endorsements from unrelated corners, each one plain and ivory-clear. Forging independent paths means persuading unconnected agents to risk their own standing, and a single shared marble of intermediary evidence collapses a path outright.
